entities.name: Urânia Vanério
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Urânia Vanério de Argollo Ferrão was a Brazilian teacher, writer and translator. In her childhood she witnessed the conflict between Brazilian and Portuguese troops in early 1822, in the context of the Bahia's independence process, which led her to write the poem "Lamentos de uma Baiana...".
